approval_basis: User required 20 mm/10 degree success, allowed ad hoc teacher construction, required fast pre-Isaac screening, and required systemic guards against invalid evidence reuse. The current-run contract hash-binds and enforces C3 human posture rejections, separates the 19.5 mm acceptance threshold from the 30 mm generation target, and preserves every contact, clearance, joint-reserve, safety, QPID/QP, and local-servo gate. A hash-bound successful posture from the same morphology may initialize configuration-space search only; it does not seed the contact goal or change contact IK. A finite teacher option may be fixed only after a hash-bound complete CPU screen reports trajectory completion and eligibility for the full control test without changing any gate. Reselecting a teacher option after an Isaac collision still requires both a bounded failure and an independent single-candidate replay, with pi_L actor commands disabled. A repeated fixed-support collision may raise the grasp contact height only after both replays identify the same non-grasp body and the raised option passes the unchanged complete CPU screen.
